acceptance_criteria.criterion: The one-shot GitHub-native Source Handling bootstrap entrypoint is exercised end to end at the command boundary against a real anchored ledger, covering the first bootstrap, idempotent re-dispatch, tampered and foreign pre-existing ledgers, anchor weakening, trust-root and signing-key mismatches, re-run refusal, lost compare-and-swap, crash before and after a durable write with prefix recovery, single-ref write scope, and secret non-disclosure.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: tests/test_issue_agent_source_handling_bootstrap_entry.py (26 entrypoint tests driving scripts/hunter_issue_agent_lifecycle.py against a local bare remote and an authenticated GitHub read double; includes a replay-operational-failure redispatch-refusal regression and the same-family corruption freeze is pinned by existing tests).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every refusal the bootstrap can raise is a bounded, documented machine-checked refusal or freeze code rather than an unhandled traceback, and failure leaves no out-of-scope durable write.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_issue_agent_lifecycle.py cmd_source_handling_bootstrap translation layer, the store git normalization, the workspace/sqlite operational refusals, and the `_apply` replay re-raise of sqlite3.OperationalError (raw, so the lifecycle reports its sanitized re-dispatch refusal) with the corruption message carrying no sqlite payload; every refusal path is mutation-checked (RED without the fix, GREEN with it) and the focused S6 suite (200 tests, including 26 entrypoint tests) is green; no Traceback in stdout or stderr for any refusal path.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: ADR 0038 Implementation Status and the ADR 0037 S6 status text describe the implementation that actually exists after PR #562 and PR #564, without claiming a dispatched bootstrap or a written state ref.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: docs/ADR/0038-source-handling-github-native-authority-store.md and docs/ADR/0037-github-native-issue-agent-execution.md edits in this range; Architecture Index Guard PASS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The range introduces no second Source Handling authority, ledger, SPM, DPM or publisher, changes no trust root or pinned authorization rule, dispatches no bootstrap, and writes no production state ref.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Changed paths are limited to the added entrypoint test suite, the lifecycle entrypoint translation layer, the ledger store git normalization, the canonicalization writer-identity pin with its `env` identity sanitizer and adversarial regression, the `_apply` replay operational re-raise and its store/entry-level regressions, the ADR 0038/0037 bodies and their index, and this generated artifact; config/issue_agent_trust_roots.json and the workflows are untouched, and refs/heads/hunter-state/v1/source-handling remains absent on origin.
